$comment: Traceability matrix: every bullet of the pdfnative CHANGELOG entry named by `engine` is either exercised THROUGH pdfnative-react (named tests, and baseline samples where a sample can show it) or waived with a reason. tests/regression/engine-surface.test.ts holds every reference to the tree. Extend it in the same change that moves the pdfnative peer pin (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Bumping the engine pin'). Item ids and changelog prefixes are shared with pdfnative-mcp's and pdfnative-cli's matrices, so the three wrappers can be compared line by line. Waiver kinds: LIB (an engine API the authoring surface deliberately does not carry — golden rule 7 — or an internal of the engine with no JSX/DocSpec-facing behaviour), TOOLING / DOCS (the engine repository's own build, CI, samples or documentation), tested-upstream (a rule of the engine the renderer only transmits — `transmission` names the suite that proves the transmission), upstream-limit (observable through the renderer but wrong or incomplete in the engine; see `upstreamLimits`).
